name: WereGarurumon (X Antibody)
main_effect: [When Digivolving] By trashing 2 cards in your hand, unsuspend this Digimon. Then, if [WereGarurumon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may return 1 Digimon card with [Garurumon] or [X Antibody] in its name from your trash to the hand.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name, by trashing 1 card in your hand, unsuspend this Digimon.
